dia_chi_raw: Tòa nhà Fafim Việt Nam, 19 Nguyễn Trãi
mo_ta_cong_viec:
You will join a dynamic and experienced engineering team, operating and evolving cloud infrastructure and SaaS platforms that serve more than 1,000 leading global corporations, including Vodafone, Nokia, Shell, Carlsberg, NTT, Sony, Mitsubishi, Samsung, and many others.
You will work directly with production systems at global scale, spanning on-premise infrastructure and public cloud environments, and actively participate in our transition toward cloud-native architectures.
You will research, learn, and apply modern Cloud, DevOps, and CI/CD technologies, contributing to building secure, scalable, and high-performance platforms for our financial and Investor Relations products.
Key Responsibilities:
Operate and manage hybrid infrastructure, including:
On-premise servers and data center systems
Cloud infrastructure on Azure and/or AWS
Deploy, manage, and optimize Cloud and PaaS services, such as:
Managed compute: Azure App Service, Functions, Container Apps, VMs (AWS EC2, Lambda, ECS or equivalents)
Databases and storage: Azure SQL, Blob Storage (AWS RDS, S3 or equivalents)
Networking: Azure Front Door, VNET, DNS (AWS CloudFront, VPC, Route 53)
Participate in migrating systems from on-premise or VM-based deployments to cloud-native and PaaS solutions
Design, provision, and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, Azure Bicep, ARM templates, or AWS CloudFormation).
Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, etc.)
Integrate DevSecOps security practices into pipelines, including automated code scanning, dependency checks, and secret management (Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault). 
Implement and manage Observability solutions, including continuous monitoring, centralized logging, and alerting systems
Work closely with development teams to support build and deployment processes
Monitor systems, troubleshoot incidents, and optimize performance, availability, and cost
Apply best practices in:
Cloud architecture and operations
Security, IAM, networking, and SSL/TLS
Write technical documentation and contribute to continuous process improvement
yeu_cau:
At least 2 years of experience in one or more of the following roles: Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer
Hands-on experience with at least one of major cloud platforms: Azure or AWS (Azure is preferred, AWS experience is fully acceptable)
Solid understanding of:
Virtual machines, networking, DNS, load balancing
Linux and Windows server administration
Proficient with major CI/CD tools & GitOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.
Proficient scripting skills: Bash, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent
Experience with containers (Docker, Container Apps, AKS, ECS, etc.)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and basic DevSecOps practices (SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, etc.).
Strong learning mindset, proactive attitude, and good teamwork skills.*** Preferred Qualifications:
Cloud certifications (Azure or AWS) are a plus
Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, particularly Terraform or Bicep/CloudFormation.
Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and APM tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, Azure Monitor, or AWS CloudWatch)
Good English communication skills.
quyen_loi:
Lương, thưởng và các chế độ đãi ngộ hấp dẫn
Môi trường chuyên nghiệp, khóa đào tạo nâng cao
Du lịch, team building, gói bảo hiểm sức khỏe

Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience and capability. Regular salary reviews every 6–12 months, aligned with performance and contributions. 13th-month salary and bonuses for public holidays and Lunar New Year.
Opportunities to join company-sponsored training programs, including English language courses, technical training, and professional skill development aligned with job requirements. Opportunities for overseas onsite work, conferences, workshops, and training.
Work on international-scale projects, with opportunities for business trips and training both domestically and abroad.
Professional working processes in a modern, open, and creative environment with a young, dynamic team.
Multinational working environment, collaborating directly with colleagues from different countries.
Company trips and vacations twice per year, along with regular team-building activities such as weekly tea breaks, football, billiards, games, camping, and other social events.
Participation in a premium health insurance package.
Annual health check-ups and full social insurance coverage based on 100% of gross salary.
Monday to Friday flexible working schedule
A commitment to long-term, stable employment.
